name: Twilight Lord Kelris
summary: At Blackfathom Deeps, Twilight Lord Kelris leads the Twilight's Hammer from the sunken ruins. The orc warlock holds high rank in the cult and directs its rites in the Moonshrine Sanctum. There, his followers worship Aku'mai and seek a reign of cosmic chaos.

sections.title: Herald of the Void
sections.body: Twilight Lord Kelris directs the cultists who seized the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. For years, he slipped past watchful eyes in Darnassus and evaded the Argent Dawn. Whenever ancient malice stirred across Kalimdor, Kelris was suspected of being behind it. He pledged himself to the Old Gods, not to warlords or clans. He seeks to unmake mortal civilization and return Azeroth to primordial chaos.

sections.title: Keeper of the Beast
sections.body: In the Moonshrine Sanctum, Kelris oversees the cult's worship of Aku'mai, a vicious three-headed hydra who serves an Old God. Allied with the naga, the Twilight's Hammer occupies the drowned temple. Kelris leads the cult's rites and sacrifices innocents to Aku'mai in exchange for power.

sections.title: Dark Trance and Slumber
sections.body: Twilight Lord Kelris commands potent shadow magic that can seize minds and plunge intruders into deep, unnatural sleep. He prays without cease before a corrupted altar ringed by candles that channel dark energies. Anyone who tries to strike him down must defeat the cult leader and face the latent horrors stirred when his ritual vigil is broken.

faq.answer: Twilight Lord Kelris is an orc sorcerer and high-ranking leader who commands the Twilight's Hammer in Blackfathom Deeps. He directs the cult's activity throughout the sunken temple and is devoted to the Old Gods.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn hunting Kelris?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn hunts Kelris as an elusive instigator of malice throughout Kalimdor. Though he was once believed dead or missing, his hand was found behind numerous dark plots across the continent, making his elimination a priority.

faq.q: What is Kelris doing with the hydra Aku'mai?
faq.answer: Kelris and his Twilight's Hammer cultists worship Aku'mai, a three-headed hydra who serves an Old God. The beast lairs in the deepest part of the sunken temple.

faq.q: What happens after Kelris is defeated?
faq.answer: Behind Kelris stands an altar with four ceremonial candles. Lighting them unbinds the sanctum's protective wards, summons waves of Aku'mai's servants, and opens the sealed gate to the beast's lair.

faq.q: What powers does Kelris use in combat?
faq.answer: Kelris uses potent shadow spells, mental domination, and magical slumber to incapacitate his enemies while his dark rites continue.

Bashana Runetotem is Kelris's ally and investigates the corruption in Blackfathom Deeps. Bashana warns adventurers of Kelris's obsession with Old God worship and his desire to plunge the world back into primeval chaos.

angles.text: The Argent Dawn, operating from Darnassus, seeks to end Kelris's elusive career of stirring dark cults and terror across northern Kalimdor.
Elders and shamans see Kelris as a cautionary abomination, an orc who abandoned the elements and ancestral spirits to grovel before ancient cosmic horrors.
Typical warlocks bargain with demons of the Burning Legion. Kelris shows the shadow magic born from yielding to Old God whispers, which can induce a trance.
Kelris's blasphemous rites despoil the Moonshrine Sanctum, an ancient elven temple dedicated to Elune.
